nl: In billing/pricing.py, introduce a module-level constant VAT_RATE = 0.23 after the module docstring (one blank line before it, two blank lines after it) and use it in place of the number 0.23 in the three calculations. The string "0.23.0" in version() stays unchanged.
oracle_program:
edit "billing/pricing.py" changes: [{insert: "VAT_RATE = 0.23\n", line: 3, position: before}]
search /\b0\.23\b(?!\.0")/ "billing/pricing.py" |> replace "VAT_RATE"
reference_bash:
python3 - <<'EOF'
import os, pathlib
p = pathlib.Path('billing/pricing.py'); t = p.read_bytes().decode()
assert t.count('"""Pricing helpers."""\n\n') == 1, 'billing/pricing.py'
p.write_bytes(t.replace('"""Pricing helpers."""\n\n', '"""Pricing helpers."""\n\nVAT_RATE = 0.23\n\n').encode())
p = pathlib.Path('billing/pricing.py'); t = p.read_bytes().decode()
assert t.count('(1 + 0.23)') == 1, 'billing/pricing.py'
p.write_bytes(t.replace('(1 + 0.23)', '(1 + VAT_RATE)').encode())
p = pathlib.Path('billing/pricing.py'); t = p.read_bytes().decode()
assert t.count('net * 0.23\n') == 1, 'billing/pricing.py'
p.write_bytes(t.replace('net * 0.23\n', 'net * VAT_RATE\n').encode())
p = pathlib.Path('billing/pricing.py'); t = p.read_bytes().decode()
assert t.count('{net * 0.23:.2f}') == 1, 'billing/pricing.py'
p.write_bytes(t.replace('{net * 0.23:.2f}', '{net * VAT_RATE:.2f}').encode())
EOF
